description: This Java class 'ImmutableEnforcementFilter' is an immutable implementation of the 'EnforcementFilter' interface. It encapsulates enforcement logic involving placeholder resolution, matching input values against filters, and generating exceptions upon failure. The class manages collections of placeholders and enforcement filters, performs resolution checks, and provides standard object methods.

classes.name: ImmutableEnforcementFilter
classes.description: An immutable class implementing EnforcementFilter interface, used to enforce filters with placeholder resolution, input matching, and exception handling.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Attempts to match the input value against the enforcement filters after resolving placeholders; throws exceptions if resolution fails or if no match is found.

methods.name: getEnforcementFailedException
methods.description: Constructs a ConnectionSignalIdEnforcementFailedException when input does not match enforcement filters.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare enforcement, placeholders, and input value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash based on enforcement, placeholders, and input value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object.toString to produce a string representation of the object.
